name: L2 Puppis

planets.name: B
planets.note: Secondary continuum + CO source at projected separation rho=30.6+/-2.5 mas (R0=1.96+/-0.16 AU), coincident with the near-IR companion of Kervella et al. 2015. Orbital period ~5 yr; mass constrained to m_B=12+/-16 Mjup from the coincidence of the gas disk center of rotation with the continuum position. Likely a planet or low-mass brown dwarf, possibly surrounded by an extended molecular atmosphere or accretion disk.
